Folkwear Sewing Patterns

Folkwear patterns help you to create clothing from around the world and across the decades. Beautiful designs, clear sewing instructions, and options for paper or PDF patterns - our sewing patterns will help you create amazing garments. Since the 1970s, Folkwear patterns have been used by individuals who want to connect with their culture, as well as film, theatre and dance costumers, historic reenactors, art-to-wear aficionados, and anyone who enjoys sewing and dressing in classic clothes. Our detailed patterns help you to create clothing that is timeless, unique and useful. Whether you are an enthusiastic beginner or an experienced sewist, you'll find something to love in Folkwear sewing patterns.

Join our Folkwear Sewing Patterns facebook group here to meet others who enjoy sewing with traditional and historical patterns.

This month's featured pattern

136 Children's Kimono & Vests

$21.95

| /

Sizes: 2 - 10

Here is an authentic and versatile selection of Japanese garments for boys and girls, sized 2 to 10. The Children's Kimono has the same basic cut and construction as our adult pattern, 113 Japanese Kimono. And, two vest patterrns, one quilted, one knitted, are also provided.  Tips for making and wearing a traditional Obi sash are included, as well.
